scope: Read-only Xorg/GNOME diagnosis; no board, serial, production configuration or source changes

conclusions.depth30: Local per-depth pixmap fallback. Xorg 21.1.16 glamor_add_format selects formats[depth]; the read format/type mismatch returns before setting rendering_supported. Only affected-depth allocations then use fbCreatePixmap. formats 24/32 and 30 are independently and unconditionally probed, so DefaultDepth 24 does not suppress the depth30 probe/warning.
conclusions.hardware: The captured Xorg log explicitly reports PowerVR B-Series BXM-4-64 glamor acceleration and no depth24/32 format failure. This establishes hardware EGL/GLES initialization; it is not comprehensive desktop/application acceptance.
conclusions.glx: AIGLX message means DRI2 createNewScreen returned NULL. The subsequent DRISWRAST provider selects the __DRI_SWRAST extension. It is separate from the active hardware EGL/GLES glamor context.
conclusions.same_hash: pvr_dri.so, sunxi-drm_dri.so, swrast_dri.so and zink_dri.so in the packaged vendor bundle all have SHA256 445406ab0c2a23c6ee2cb5e7e2187f968be6f545167a91ca67a234b3e92bb48a and 16993848 bytes. This is a multi-driver megadriver exporting distinct entry points. Equal hashes do not establish hardware rendering for the swrast entry.
conclusions.software_implementation: The megadriver has a local softpipe_create_screen function and no LLVM NEEDED entry. The only observed llvmpipe string is VK_DRIVER_ID_MESA_LLVMPIPE. Software GLX is plausible, most likely softpipe; exact active GLX renderer requires a separate GLX context query and is not claimed here.
conclusions.gnome: Mutter 48.7 selects EGL_XLIB for COGL_DRIVER=gles2 and GLX for GL3. The runtime already reports a high-priority EGL context. The captured fatal exit is GTK4 undefined vkCreateWaylandSurfaceKHR, not the depth30 or GLX message. Fixing the Vulkan-loader selection is the immediate prerequisite for the next desktop test.
conclusions.secondary_gpu: modeset(G0) tries render-only card1 as an extra KMS device and fails with packed24bpp/KMS setup errors. Primary modeset(0) still initializes. AutoAddGPU=false can suppress unnecessary Xorg GPU-screen creation after explicit card0 selection, but is not an EGL/GLX fix and needs a separate confirmation of primary/DRI3/render-node operation.

minimal_configuration_recommendation.immediate: Keep existing explicit modesetting card0, glamor, SWcursor=true, PageFlip=false and COGL_DRIVER=gles2; first change only the Vulkan-loader conflict under the other agent's ownership.
minimal_configuration_recommendation.optional_sdr: Augment the intended existing Screen, or add one only if absent: Device "T736 display engine", DefaultDepth 24, DefaultFbBpp 32. Do not force packed 24 bits per pixel. This fixes the main screen format, not all offered pixmap/visual depths.
minimal_configuration_recommendation.optional_secondary_gpu: If G0 remains noisy or destabilizing after desktop works, add only ServerFlags Option "AutoAddGPU" "false" while retaining explicit card0. Verify primary modeset, DRI3 and PowerVR EGL again. Leave input auto-discovery unchanged.
avoid: Do not disable GLX or AIGLX just to silence this log
Do not remove swrast_dri.so from the vendor megadriver package
Do not set MESA_LOADER_DRIVER_OVERRIDE=pvr globally on split display/render devices
Do not treat absence of the depth30 warning as a success requirement
acceptance: EGL X11 draw/readback probe identifies PowerVR
GNOME Shell remains running with vendor EGL/GLES and no loader-symbol error
Actual GNOME renderer verified, normal window creation/composition and physical HDMI observed
Treat native GLX application support as a separate unresolved capability
